rules.accepted_credit_types: CNE from providers approved by any state board of nursing, national nursing credentialing bodies or KSBN; other offerings (incl. college courses, ACLS/PALS from non-approved providers) need an Individual Offering Approval before renewal
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required if the license expires within 30 months after the initial licensure exam, or within 9 months after reinstatement or endorsement.
rules.audit_note: Nurses must have certificates for the 30 hours ready to submit if audited.
rules.notes: CE Broker is the board's official (free) tracking system. 1 contact hour = 50 minutes. Expiry basis of the biennial license not stated on the pages read.
rules.rule_quote: LPN and RN CNE renewal requirements: 30 contact hours of approved CNE during the most recent licensing period.
